"""Verify the greeting command and the one-line rule."""

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
greeting_file = root / "src" / "greeting.txt"
command_file = root / "src" / "greet.py"

# Source-of-truth file exists
assert greeting_file.is_file(), "src/greeting.txt must exist"

# One-line rule
text = greeting_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
lines = text.splitlines()
assert len(lines) == 1, f"greeting must be one line, got {len(lines)}"

# Command file exists
assert command_file.is_file(), "src/greet.py must exist"

# Command prints the greeting correctly
result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, str(command_file)],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    cwd=str(root),
)
assert result.returncode == 0, f"command failed: {result.stderr}"
assert result.stdout.strip() == lines[0], f"output mismatch: {result.stdout!r}"
